Name: recolor of wee highland coos Adopt n Skin needed
Author: WiccanKitten911
Description:
A adopt n skin texture made with Wee Highland Coos sprites.  For the actual mod please see https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/60?tab=files&file_id=381.  This is just a recolor and add on to make it compatible with adopt n skin.  I like recoloring my Adopt n skin sprites to perfection in photoshop and thought other might want to use them as well; so heres some recolors.

To use, please download the zip containing the textures to the cows, once there but the cows into the corrospoding adopt n skin folder.  make sure the numbers are not overriding with other textures.  (ex having two Browncow_29's).
